sections.description: Content Studio: featured image feeds the Open Graph preview, the panel remembers your last section, and new posts follow the site's discussion defaults.
sections.changelog:
v1.3.420 - Dev

  • Featured image is used as the Open Graph / social image. When no explicit Facebook/Twitter/OG image is set, the social share previews (and output) now fall back to the post’s featured image instead of showing an empty placeholder.
  • Content Studio remembers the last section. Reopening it returns to the content type you were in (Pages, Posts, a CPT…) instead of snapping back to Pages.
  • New posts follow the site’s discussion defaults. Content Studio no longer forces comments and pingbacks closed on new posts — it uses the site’s Settings → Discussion defaults, so the Posts list ping/comment status matches everything else.

v1.3.419 - Dev

  • Double-tap U now actually unlinks the component. Bricks exposes no component-unlink on its builder API (only the legacy global-element one, which no-ops on components), so MV reconstructs it: it clones the component’s element tree into the page with fresh ids, reuses the instance as the new root, drops the cid link, and — crucially — resolves the instance’s component properties (title, description, image, attributes, etc.) onto the detached elements using Bricks’ own $_applyComponentPropertyLogic, so the unlinked section keeps its current content. The toast now only reports success after verifying the link is gone.

v1.3.418 - Dev

  • Double-tap U unlink now bound to Bricks' real API. The shortcut calls Bricks’ own $_unlinkGlobalElement (components grew out of Bricks’ older “global elements”, which is why the unlink keeps that name), gated by Bricks’ own $_isComponentRoot/$_getElementComponent checks so it only fires on a real component instance. The earlier build probed for method names that don’t exist in this Bricks version.

v1.3.417 - Dev

  • Double-tap U unlinks the selected component. Mirroring double-tap R (rename), tapping U twice with a component instance selected detaches it into normal, independently-editable elements. It routes through Bricks’ own unlink so ids, overrides and nested components stay intact; if a Bricks build exposes no unlink API, MV captures the available builder methods to the console instead of guessing.
  • Bricks Settings remembers the last group. Reopening the panel returns to the group you were last in (e.g. Custom code, Custom HTML tags) instead of snapping back to General.
  • Custom HTML tags panel is tidier. The Common additions now read as styled add-chips, and the Show-descriptions toggle is hidden on that view where it has nothing to describe.

v1.3.416 - Dev

  • Right-click “All media” for a real context menu. The All media row now has its own right-click menu with the actions that make sense for the whole library — View all media, New collection, and Download all media. Collection-only actions (rename, star, colour, subfolder, lock, shortcode, delete) are correctly left off.
  • Download the entire media library as one ZIP. Download all media gathers every attachment server-side (not just the loaded/paginated grid), so the whole library is packaged even on large sites, with progress shown in the upload surface.

v1.3.415 - Dev

  • Add custom allowed HTML tags to Bricks from MV. Bricks Settings gains a Custom HTML tags group where you can add tags such as picture, source, or a custom element and remove them again. MV merges them into Bricks through the bricks/allowed_html_tags filter (front end and builder), so those tags are no longer stripped from code elements and raw HTML — no PHP snippet required. Common additions are one click, and the list persists in its own option.

v1.3.414 - Dev

  • Blocks are clearer and faster to edit. Paragraphs use the Paragraph label, double Alt opens Add block at the caret and inserts below the active block, and the Block tab now provides contextual duplicate, move, delete, and add-below actions.
  • Publishing fields behave naturally. Light-mode focus styling stays readable, nested-row tooltips match Expand or Collapse, and the permalink follows title changes until it is edited directly.
  • Rank Math live scoring is restored. Content Studio waits for the available analyzer, populates its current Paper API, and uses ResultManager scoring while leaving Rank Math stored scores read-only.
  • Embedded media is stable. Media Studio keeps its complete dark presentation inside light Content Studio, stale list responses cannot deselect a new collection, and one upload surface transitions from progress to the final summary without overlap or avoidable wrapping.

v1.3.413 - Dev

  • Content Studio now uses Media Studio itself. Removed the separate title-chip image browser and mounted the shared Media Studio picker for inline, featured, and SEO images, including the same collections, search, filters, layouts, uploads, thumbnails, and details.
  • The first frame is stable. Picker mode starts with the image filter already applied and Media Studio prepaints its warm shared cache, so reopening no longer flashes a mismatched interim browser before thumbnails arrive.

v1.3.412 - Dev

  • Documentation module state is consistent. Disabling Documentation for Admin or Builder now removes Docs from that surface's Studio rail and speed dial, blocks global toggle requests, and immediately closes any stale open Documentation panel. Settings remains available so modules can always be re-enabled.

v1.3.411 - Dev

  • Cool blue-grey fully removed. A second .ve-btn-g definition still carried the old #303236 and overrode the neutral fix — now neutral everywhere. Also neutralized the other blue-leaning greys used across surfaces (#2b2d31, #34373b, #3a3d42). All secondary buttons, toolbars and rows now read as true neutral grey with no blue cast.

v1.3.410 - Dev

  • Secondary button surface + icon hovers. The secondary button (.ve-btn-g) surface changes from the cool blue-grey #303236 to neutral #2f2f2f (matches MV's surface palette) everywhere it appears. Theme-style row actions now use neutral icons that colour on hover only — copy → lime, delete → red — via reusable .ve-ih-copy / .ve-ih-del classes.

v1.3.409 - Dev

  • Root cause of the code-editor scroll (#35). MV’s CodeMirror detection only accepted a stylesheet named codemirror.css, but MV ships codemirror.scoped.css — so in wp-admin every code field silently fell back to a plain textarea (no real scroller). Detection now recognises MV’s own stylesheet, so real CodeMirror mounts and the inline editor scrolls natively with syntax highlighting + suggestions.

v1.3.408 - Dev

  • Inline code editor scroll fix (#35). Removed the custom .CodeMirror-scroll height overrides that desynced CodeMirror’s scroll model (scrollbar showed but the wheel couldn’t move it). The inline editor now uses a fixed-height host and lets CodeMirror manage its own scroller, exactly like the working CSS Studio editor.

v1.3.407 - Dev

  • Code editor scroll — native CodeMirror scroll (#35/#36). Inline editors are back to a normal capped height (260px) that scrolls; the pop-out fills its panel and scrolls to the last line. The window wheel-broker that intercepted scrolling across the last several versions is disabled, so CodeMirror's own scroll (which always reaches the final line) is in charge and then chains to the panel. The studio rail is hidden while a field is popped out, removing the double-nav-bar.

v1.3.406 - Dev

  • Code editor scroll finally fixed (#35/#36). Inline and popped-out Bricks code editors now grow to their content (CodeMirror auto-height) and the surrounding panel is the single scroller — no nested editor scroll to get stuck on, so you reach the last line every time and keep scrolling into the panel/footer. Replaces the fixed-height + wheel-broker approach that kept stalling before the final line.

v1.3.405 - Dev

  • Firefox wheel scrolling is handled before panel mount. One early broker routes standard wheel, Firefox DOMMouseScroll, and legacy mousewheel using CodeMirror native scrollbar measurements.
  • Diagnostics are actually available. mimamVarInspectCodeEditors() is exposed immediately in panel and same-origin top-frame consoles.
  • Cross-browser acceptance is explicit. Physical wheel tests in Firefox 153.0.1 and Chromium reached the final inline and pop-out line, handed inline boundary scrolling to Settings, and preserved the pop-out footer.

v1.3.404 - Dev

  • Wheel input reaches CodeMirror before Bricks. Inline and pop-out editors capture at the window boundary, reach their measured final line, and expose on-demand console diagnostics.
  • Custom Code stays visible. Execution, Styles, and Scripts remain expanded instead of becoming accordion toggles; other Bricks Settings groups keep the accepted calm grouping.
  • Boundary scrolling is deliberate. Continued wheel input moves the settings panel after an inline editor reaches its edge, while pop-outs remain isolated above the accepted footer.

v1.3.403 - Dev

  • Physical wheel scrolling reaches the final line. Inline and pop-out CodeMirror editors consume wheel input while they can move, then release it to the surrounding panel at either boundary.
  • Theme Styles is Bricks-native. Phase 1 adds CRUD, conditions, whole-style controls, and Custom CSS directly against bricks_theme_styles; per-element defaults remain Phase 2.
  • Bricks Settings is calmer. Settings use collapsible subsections with optional descriptions while preserving global search and native saves.
  • HTML and JavaScript highlighting is real. Header and body script fields use vendored CodeMirror XML, JavaScript, and HTML Mixed modes inline and popped out.

v1.3.401 - Dev

  • Code editors reach the real bottom. Inline and popped-out CodeMirror instances own bounded scroll areas, the pop-out footer remains visible, the studio rail stays immediately beside the pop-out, and the stale dock-back tooltip is gone.
  • Video details keep their complete controls. Attachment videos use a dedicated intrinsic-ratio card, including the hover/focus seekbar and Play, Sound, and Volume row before Metadata.
  • Content SEO is clearer and authoritative. Focus keywords use compact full-width wrapped rows, and when Rank Math is active Content Studio reads its stored score without overwriting it.

v1.3.400 - Dev

  • Bricks code editors fixed & unified. Inline editors now hold a fixed height (no more overflow/stray markers); when a field is popped out the studio rail moves to the far left, clear of the pop-out; and all code fields (Custom CSS + header/body scripts) now mount the shared CSS Studio editor — CSS gets full highlighting + suggestions, script fields use the same editor (plain until HTML/JS modes are bundled). Clearer “open in the side panel” note on the docked field.

v1.3.399 - Dev

  • One code editor everywhere (#35/#36). The Bricks Settings Custom CSS field now mounts MV’s CSS Studio editor (CodeMirror + ./#/-- suggestions) — one source of truth for highlighting. Any code field has a ↗ pop-out that opens it in a 410px full-height side panel beside the settings, with a single undock control and ⌘/Ctrl+S to save (no button). HTML/JS script fields keep the styled editor for now (only the CSS mode is bundled).

v1.3.398 - Dev

  • Everything feedback stays visible. Selection/opening toasts move above the Bar when needed and remain clamped inside the viewport.
  • Video Attachment Details stays intact. Successful and failed previews reserve their own space; a seekbar appears on hover or keyboard focus.
  • Masonry uses true video geometry. Intrinsic video dimensions drive tile height and column balancing without cropping portrait media.
  • Content SEO acceptance is clearer. Long focus keywords show in full, all SEO edits become unsaved changes, and Save SEO & score persists the current analysis.

v1.3.397 - Dev

  • Everything selections now confirm immediately. Results announce what was selected and where it is opening.
  • Video previews fit portrait media. Controls sit below the video and Play/Pause plus Sound use icons; Caption and Description are taller.
  • Content SEO acceptance fixes. Meta descriptions stay multi-line, focus-keyword pills wrap, and the computed score persists after save/reopen.
  • Media feedback no longer overlaps. Upload progress reserves space for the completion toast.
  • Output units are clearer. New-token defaults and optional existing-token conversion are separate, with a review step before rewriting.

v1.3.396 - Dev

  • Media Studio opens with media already waiting. The library warms in the background, persists for the current admin session, paints the first page progressively, and refreshes without blanking a usable gallery.
  • Video files now show real frames. MP4, WEBM, MOV, M4V, and OGV tiles load lazily near the viewport; selecting a video provides Play/Pause, Sound on/off, and Volume controls.

v1.3.395 - Dev

  • Media Studio scrolling is restored across the complete panel. The normal Studio bridge now stays within the visible panel height, so Collections, grid/masonry/list media, Attachment Details, and batch actions scroll independently while New Collection remains reachable.
  • Bricks picker mode is preserved. Its context bridge keeps the existing display layout while the normal Studio receives the bounded flex height chain.

v1.3.394 - Dev

  • Media Studio collections list scrolls again. With many collections the list overflowed and clipped — the sidebar body now scrolls (header pinned on top) and the New Collection / folder actions stay visible at the bottom.

v1.3.393 - Dev

  • Output unit control looks cleaner (Settings → General) — single-line segmented labels (rem @10 / rem @16 / px / raw) and a tidy preview strip.
  • Bricks Settings custom-code editors are taller (Custom CSS / header / body scripts) for comfortable editing. Syntax highlighting and a pop-out editor panel are next.

v1.3.392 - Dev

  • Meta description field is tall again (#7). A global control-height rule was clamping every SEO textarea to one line via max-height; the meta description (and social descriptions) now honor their intended height.
  • SEO score persists and reflects your edits (#9). Content Studio now writes its live analysis score on save, so the content list shows the current score instead of a stale Rank Math value that never refreshed.
  • Focus-keyword pills flattened (no gradient) and set to shrink/truncate cleanly (#8).

v1.3.391 - Dev

  • Bricks Settings reads cleaner. Removed the developer key clutter, bigger type, full descriptions under each label, and more breathing room per row — matching the native Bricks settings readability.
  • Documentation now appears on the studio side rail (and both Bricks Settings and Documentation are now listed in the per-module Backdrop and Module toggles).
  • Removed the gradients in the Documentation module (hero + card glows) to match the no-gradient rule.

v1.3.390 - Dev

  • Bricks Settings — multiselects & actions now live (#24, #25). Post types and Excluded templates are editable chip pickers; SVG-upload roles and Code-execution roles grant/revoke the real Bricks capabilities (via Bricks’ own capability API). The Block-editor ↔ Bricks converters and “Delete all Bricks data on uninstall” are live toggles, and Performance adds a Regenerate CSS files action. Only the builder-access role matrix (customCapabilities) remains “manage in Bricks” for now.

v1.3.389 - Dev

  • Bricks Settings inside MV (#23). A new Bricks Settings module (studio rail + speed dial) opens a docked 410px panel that reads and writes Bricks’ own bricks_global_settings — the same store as Bricks → Settings, so changes apply to native Bricks too. Grouped by Bricks’ own tabs (General, Builder access, Templates, Builder, Performance, Maintenance, API keys, Custom code, WooCommerce) with search across all groups. Live-editable: every toggle, the key selects (exact Bricks enum values), API keys, numbers, and the Custom CSS/scripts editors. WooCommerce group shows only when Woo is active. Maintenance links to MV’s existing Site Visibility. Destructive/complex items (data converters, delete-all, access matrix, multiselects) are shown read-only and marked “manage in Bricks” for now.

v1.3.388 - Dev

  • Convert existing tokens to any unit (#19). Settings → General → Output unit gains a Convert existing tokens button with its own unit dropdown — it re-expresses every stored dimension token (rem, px, or raw) in one pass and adopts that unit as the default. The top control still governs new tokens only; the button rewrites what already exists. Values that can’t be cleanly converted (clamp/fluid, %, vw, var) are left untouched.

v1.3.387 - Dev

  • Output unit control (#19). Choose how dimension tokens are written — rem (1rem=10px), rem (1rem=16px), px, or raw (no unit) — from Settings → General in WordPress or the Figma plugin’s Settings; the two share one setting. It drives variables.css and every export, and governs Figma push/create so values are authored raw and take the unit at output. Default is rem (1rem=10px), so existing values are unchanged until re-saved.

v1.3.386 - Dev

  • Backdrop behind studio panels, per module (#18). Blur/dim the page behind an open studio. Settings → Studio preferences adds an intensity picker (Blur + dim / Soft / Dim only / None) and per-module switches. Defaults: Blur + dim, on for the studios, off for the docked Variables panel and Settings.

v1.3.385 - Dev

  • Drag a field’s right edge to set its Presentation width (#17). Fields render at their wrapper width; a handle resizes them (snapping to 5%, 15-100%) with a live percentage, and the drawer width field stays in sync.

v1.3.384 - Dev

  • Documentation module (#14). The Docs speed-dial opens a full documentation hub: a rail of modules, a home with search, module cards, Quick answers and What’s new, per-module article lists, and a rich article reader (callouts, numbered steps, command lists, keyboard chips). Built from the approved v4 mock.

v1.3.383 - Dev

  • ACF Options Pages editor (#13). A + to register a page and pencil/delete per row; the tabbed editor covers Placement (title, stable slug, parent, position, icon, description), Access (capability, redirect, autoload) and Field Groups. Saves through ACF’s acf_update_ui_options_page, merging into the existing record.
  • The category-list Autoload toggle is live for options pages, plus Edit/Delete row actions.

v1.3.382 - Dev

  • Image pickers across wp-admin open Media Studio (Site Icon, featured image, ACF image fields), not just in the builder. The wp.media bridge runs on every admin page when the Media Studio tool is enabled, falling back to the native library when Media Studio can’t handle a request. Disable the Media Studio tool to restore native pickers.

v1.3.381 - Dev

  • Enter in the Bar’s Direct mode applies the command even when a class/attribute token chip is focused — before, Enter only clicked the chip and the change was lost until you pressed Apply. Editing a token value inline still commits on Enter.

v1.3.380 - Dev

  • Focus keywords wrap instead of overflowing — long pills flow onto multiple rows and truncate cleanly.
  • The SEO score updates live as you type, computed from the on-page checks, not just the last saved Rank Math score.
  • A notice shows when Rank Math is not active.

v1.3.379 - Dev

  • The featured image shows its actual thumbnail in the content editor rail instead of a generic icon.
  • Taller meta-description field in the SEO preview editor.

v1.3.378 - Dev

  • Custom post types are reliably tagged ACF-editable, so the category list shows working toggle switches (not read-only pills) and the edit/row actions open the editor. Source detection uses ACF’s UI-created post-type definitions and tolerates both array and string shapes.

v1.3.377 - Dev

  • The category list now matches the reference prototype. Full columns (Singular, Slug, Description, Front prefix, post-type badges), inline toggle switches that save through ACF for post types and taxonomies, a search box, Add, and Edit / Duplicate / Delete row actions. Default content types stay read-only (WordPress).

v1.3.376 - Dev

  • Clicking a section header lists that category’s items (#8). Default Content Types, Custom Post Types, Taxonomies, Options Pages and Custom Field Groups open a table of their items with status and Edit/Delete actions; the caret alone toggles collapse now, and clicking a row opens that item.
  • Options Pages hides externally-registered pages — only ACF-UI-created pages are listed; plugin/theme code registrations (e.g. Advanced Themer) are hidden.

v1.3.375 - Dev

  • Taxonomies list hides internal plumbing — MV’s media-collection taxonomy and Bricks’ template Tag/Bundle no longer appear; only real content-model taxonomies show.
  • Creating a child collection reliably opens it — the new collection is re-selected by label once the server sync returns, instead of the guessed key being reset to All.

v1.3.374 - Dev

  • Custom Taxonomies editor (#8). A Taxonomies section lists custom taxonomies; the + registers a new one and clicking one opens a tabbed ACF editor (General with assigned post types, Labels, Visibility, Permalinks, REST). Saves through acf_update_taxonomy, merging into the existing record; delete keeps terms.
  • Upload success toast no longer overlaps the upload progress card.

v1.3.373 - Dev

  • Uploaded media keep spaces in their names. The upload path percent-encoded the filename into the header, so WordPress stripped the % and left “20”; it is sent header-safe with spaces now.
  • Bar suggestions are faster again — debounce cut to ~120-150 ms.
  • Creating a child collection opens it — sub-collections select and expand their parent branch on creation.

v1.3.372 - Dev

  • Picking an image for a component instance applies on the first try. The control’s writable field sometimes mounts a frame after the picker confirms, so the first insert found nothing; the lock is released on that miss and the insert retries once automatically.

v1.3.371 - Dev

  • Safe Add no longer pauses custom/third-party elements — adding an element like Slot inserts it directly.
  • Imported media keep spaces in their names — a source name with %20 is decoded before sanitising (URL, content-disposition, and ZIP imports).
  • Typing // closes the Bar.
  • Bar suggestions are snappier — debounced at ~200-240 ms instead of 620-760 ms.
  • “Use Selected Media” sits above the metadata when picking.
  • Creating a collection in Media Studio opens it.

v1.3.370 - Dev

  • Option grids are toggle switches now. The field-group Presentation “Hide on screen” list and the post-type editor’s “Editor supports” and “Taxonomy assignments” grids used square checkboxes; each option is a labelled toggle switch now, matching the rest of MV’s controls.

v1.3.369 - Dev

  • Removed the stray horizontal scrollbar along the bottom of the ACF field-group and post-type editors. Those settings panes fit their width, so a sideways scrollbar was always wrong; they scroll vertically only now, and the post-type editor’s two-column rows shrink instead of overflowing.

v1.3.368 - Dev

  • The floating settings speed dial only opens from the gear. Hovering anywhere in the button’s column — including the empty space above the gear where the tool icons sit — used to reveal the whole speed dial. It now opens only when you hover the gear itself, and still stays open while you move onto the tools.

v1.3.367 - Dev

  • Full Custom Post Types editor — editing or registering a post type now opens a tabbed ACF registration screen: General (labels, key, menu icon, description, public, hierarchical, editor supports, taxonomies), Labels, Visibility, Permalinks, Capabilities and REST API. Before, only the labels could be changed.
  • Saves through ACF — every value persists via ACF’s own post-type API, merging into the existing record so its key and any unexposed settings stay attached.
  • Older-ACF or JetEngine post types keep the labels-only behaviour.

v1.3.366 - Dev

  • Dropdown menus scroll properly again — hovering an option re-anchored the list, so every wheel notch snapped it back. Long menus also get more height.
  • Field-group controls match the chrome around them — selects and inputs sat at a 4px radius beside 8-12px cards and buttons.
  • The field-group editor fills the panel height instead of leaving dead space below the drawer.
  • The preview title bar is labelled as the post editor preview, not a group setting.

v1.3.365 - Dev

  • Field-group panes now have real padding and spacing — tabs, Location Rules, Presentation and Group Settings sat flush to the panel edge.
  • The field drawer fills the panel height instead of stopping partway down.
  • Dropdowns in the ACF editor are MV-styled — native selects rendered their menus in OS styling; they use MV’s dropdown now, with search on long lists.

v1.3.364 - Dev

  • Fixed the Presentation tab collapsing onto one line — Content Studio styles labels inline, so every setting ran together; each is its own stacked row again.
  • Download ZIP no longer renders as a blue link.
  • Location rule values are now dropdowns where MV knows the options — post types, post status, page type, user roles.

v1.3.363 - Dev

  • Made clear that creating a field group is only the first step — the create screen now says the group opens in the builder straight after, where fields and the full ACF settings live.

v1.3.362 - Dev

  • Field groups now expose everything ACF’s own screen does. Tabs beside the field builder: Location Rules (real rule builder, all 21 rule types, AND rules + OR groups), Presentation (style, position, label & instruction placement, order, full Hide-on-screen list) and Group Settings (active, REST, description, display title) — all saving through ACF.

v1.3.361 - Dev

  • An empty field group can now be built — it used to hit “No items found.” so a new group had no way to add its first field. Shows an “Add the first field” prompt instead.
  • Creating a field group opens it straight in the builder.
  • The Latest release card is gone from Release manager — it duplicated the Check-update block above.

v1.3.360 - Dev

  • ACF field groups now use the approved Live Preview builder. Opening a field group in Content Studio shows the edit screen writers actually see: click a field to edit it in the drawer (General / Validation / Presentation), hover between fields to insert, reorder / duplicate / delete inline. Changing a type re-renders the real control. Save fields writes back through ACF, updating fields in place so keys and stored content survive.

v1.3.359 - Dev

  • Release manager entries show their own version again — every row carried the same old label because the release script copied the previous entry; all existing entries repaired.
  • Removed the duplicate Update button from the Latest row; the Check-update block above already offers it.
  • The font relink picker lists font files only.

v1.3.358 - Dev

  • ACF content-model API (Content Studio groundwork). New endpoints read every ACF model in one call — field groups with their fields, post types, taxonomies, options pages — and save a field group through ACF’s own API, updating fields in place so keys and stored values survive. The approved Live Preview UI lands next.

v1.3.357 - Dev

  • The Media Studio picker now works in wp-admin, not just the Bricks builder. The media bridge effect returned early outside the builder, so the direct picker MV panels rely on was never defined there and Font Manager fell back to the WordPress library.

v1.3.356 - Dev

  • The font relink picker now opens Media Studio instead of the WordPress library. MV swaps wp.media for a Media-Studio-backed frame, but only when a recent Bricks control intent exists — a call from Font Manager had none and fell through to the native library. MV panels can now open the picker directly.

v1.3.355 - Dev

  • Updates fixed — the feed was rate-limited, not blocked. The primary feed used api.github.com (60 unauthenticated requests/hour/IP); a day of checks exhausted it and GitHub returned 403, surfaced as “Update feed blocked”. raw.githubusercontent.com serves the same manifest with no limit and is now primary.
  • Pages and Bricks templates can be opened in the WordPress editor from Everything with Shift+Enter.

v1.3.354 - Dev

  • Updates work again — the real cause. Removing the Update feed URL field left its old value in the database and the updater still read it as a fallback: a bare repo URL with no manifest path. The stored value is now ignored entirely.
  • Dismissing a toast (or using the media frame) no longer closes the open studio — the outside-click watcher runs in the capture phase, so stopPropagation could never help; both are excluded at the watcher.
  • Adding an element with nothing selected no longer errors — elements append to the canvas root.
  • Everything mode now finds Bricks templates and opens them in the builder.

v1.3.353 - Dev

  • Fixed the General settings tab doing nothing when clicked (regression in 1.3.352). The per-module tooltip switches were rendered in the Settings component but their state was declared in the app shell, so the tab threw on render.

v1.3.352 - Dev

  • Tooltips can be turned off per module — Settings lists every studio plus the speed dial/rail with its own switch.
  • The speed dial no longer closes before you reach an icon — it waited zero ms on pointer-leave; now ~320ms, cancelled when the pointer returns.
  • Fixed core Bricks elements rejected by Safe Add — the allowlist used reversed keys (basic-text) while Bricks names them text-basic, so Basic Text / Rich Text / Text link were treated as third-party.

v1.3.351 - Dev

  • Fixed updates being unreachable (“Update feed blocked”) in 1.3.349–1.3.350. The new feed constant hard-coded a bare repository URL, which lacked the manifest path and overrode the Stable/Beta/Dev channel selection. VE_UPDATE_FEED_URL and VE_LICENSE_SERVER_URL now default to empty — “use the built-in per-channel feed”, exactly as before — and only apply when deliberately defined in wp-config.php.

v1.3.350 - Dev

  • Dismissing a toast no longer closes the studio behind it — the toast renders outside every panel, so its clicks read as “clicked outside”. Its pointer events are now contained.
  • The media picker no longer closes Font Manager — the WordPress media frame renders at <body>, so clicks inside it counted as outside the panel.

v1.3.349 - Dev

  • “Relink all” no longer disappears after the first fix — it lived inside the family’s warning row, so healing one variant hid it while 8 were still broken. It now has its own strip that stays while any variant lacks a file.
  • Added “Browse media library” to the relink drawer for variants with no automatic match.
  • Unsaved-changes text no longer clips Close — compact dot + “Unsaved”, results as toasts.
  • Removed the Update feed URL and License server URL fields — now code constants (VE_UPDATE_FEED_URL / VE_LICENSE_SERVER_URL), overridable from wp-config.php.

v1.3.348 - Dev

  • Fixed Relink all failing when the right files were in the media library. Weight matching knew only one name per weight, so Lato — which calls 100 “Hairline”, not “Thin” — scored every file below the threshold. Weights now match numerals and foundry synonyms, italics must agree both ways, other families are rejected, and unsuffixed regulars are understood. All nine Lato variants resolve correctly.
  • Long toasts wait for you — over ~70 characters they drop the countdown and stay until dismissed with a ×.
  • Visibility save result is now a toast instead of a cramped footer strip.

v1.3.347 - Dev

  • Relink all now reports what it did. Progress runs on the button itself (“Scanning 3/9…”) instead of only in the far-away footer status, and the result is announced as a toast — including the previously silent “no match found” case.
  • Settings footer really stops clipping Close — the actions group had no min-width:0 so it overflowed instead of truncating the status text.
